description:
Import the airport dataset from /home/ga/airports.csv into the OrientDB 'demodb' database. 

1. Connect to 'demodb' (user: admin, pass: admin).
2. Create a new Vertex class named 'Airports'.
3. Create the following properties on 'Airports':
   - IataCode (STRING)
   - Name (STRING)
   - City (STRING)
   - Country (STRING)
   - Latitude (DOUBLE)
   - Longitude (DOUBLE)
   - Altitude (INTEGER)
4. Import the data from the CSV file. The CSV contains headers. Ensure data types are respected.
5. Create a new Edge class named 'IsInCountry'.
6. Create edges linking each Airport to the existing Country vertex matching the 'Country' field. (e.g., FCO -> Italy).
7. Create a UNIQUE index on the 'IataCode' property of the Airports class.
